column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-dev-comment-likes - likes on activity and request comments. One row per user per liked comment: a like is a single conditional put keyed by a deterministic id, an unlike is a delete. No itemType — each row self-describes its parent (activity likes set activityId, request likes set requestId). Every row carries a groupId so feeds stay isolated per household. Written by activities.py (id "comment-like#<activityId>#<commentId>#<userId>") and household_requests.py (id "request-comment-like#<requestId>#<commentId>#<userId>").
